description: This file declares the Controller class within the rialto::servermanager::ipc namespace, which implements the IController interface for managing IPC clients and configurations in the Rialto server manager component. It includes method declarations for creating, removing, and configuring clients, as well as setting log levels and performing pings.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Implements the IController interface to manage IPC clients and configurations within the Rialto server manager.

methods.name: Controller
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Controller with a reference to an ISessionServerAppManager.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client with specified server ID and application management socket.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes the client associated with the specified server ID.

methods.name: performSetConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the session server with initial state, socket name, display name, resource limits, and permissions.

methods.name: performPing
methods.description: Performs a ping operation to check client responsiveness.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for the service.
